description: Hand-labelled price-decision notes from pilot runs ab-w3, pilot3-n2 and pilot3-n10 (both models), read by hand: label_stated_price is the own price the notes explicitly state for this period (None when they state none or only conditionally); label_deviation_plan is an explicit first-person plan to undercut a rival or deviate from an agreement this period. Sampled with fixed seeds from notes the old heuristic flagged, Talk/NoTalk notes with deviation wording and other notes. Split 'dev': the 94 notes the heuristic was tuned on; split 'heldout': 36 further notes (9 Talk and 9 NoTalk per model, random) labelled before being scored; the heuristic as first scored on them got stated-price precision 25/25 and recall 25/31, deviation-plan precision 2/2 and recall 2/5.
